Export Highcharts widget to PNG

export.Rd

Export Highcharts widget to PNG

Usage

export(
  hc,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  page_width = 8.27,
  page_height = 11.69,
  factor_width = 1,
  factor_height = 1/2,
  dpi = 96,
  filename = "plot.png",
  delay = 0.5
)

Arguments

hc

htmlwidget object

width

numeric

height

numeric

page_width

numeric default 8.27 inches (A4)

page_height

numeric default 11.69 inches (A4)

factor_width

numeric default 1. Full width

factor_height

numeric default 1/2. Half page

dpi

numeric default 96

filename

character default "plot.png"

delay

numeric default 0.5
